answer: Each agent bonds 70 credits and registers one key-signed reef core, then must wander past three trellis posts; each post fresh-stamps the seal, the reef assay then weighs the core against the public trellis log. A rented-courier ring fails: a missing or reused stamp burns the bond. First filing costs 36, the k-th 36+6(k-1), so 1,000 fakes pay 3,033,000 plus 70,000 locked for 40,000 rewards. Honest agents pay 36 once and reclaim it.
